name: Eggplant

moderate.description: Larger serving, may trigger sensitive individuals

siboNotes: Eggplant is generally well-tolerated by SIBO patients at standard portions. It's versatile and can be a good meat substitute in dishes. Watch portion sizes during elimination phase.
preparationTips: Salting before cooking can reduce bitterness
Grilling or roasting brings out flavor
Can be used as a base for dips (baba ganoush)
Avoid breading to keep low FODMAP
